WITH target_usecase AS (
  SELECT usecase_id, name
  FROM "UseCase"
  WHERE usecase_id = $2
), current_active AS (
  SELECT uum.id, uum.user_id, uum.feedback_config_rule_id, uum.assigned_at, fcr.usecase_id
  FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
  WHERE uum.user_id = $1
    AND uum.active = true
  LIMIT 1
), current_same AS (
  SELECT ca.id, ca.user_id, ca.feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM current_active ca
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = ca.usecase_id
), historical AS (
  SELECT uum.feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id
  WHERE uum.user_id = $1
    AND uum.active = false
    AND fcr.active = true
  ORDER BY uum.assigned_at DESC, uum.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), default_mapping AS (
  SELECT fcr.id AS feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM feedback_config_rules fcr
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id
  WHERE fcr.active = true
  ORDER BY fcr.id
  LIMIT 1
), chosen AS (
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM current_same
  UNION ALL
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM historical
  UNION ALL
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM default_mapping
  LIMIT 1
), archived_current AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT ca.user_id, ca.feedback_config_rule_id, false, ca.assigned_at, now()
  FROM current_active ca
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_same)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chosen)
  RETURNING id
), updated_current AS (
  UPDATE "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  SET feedback_config_rule_id = chosen.feedback_config_rule_id,
      active = true,
      assigned_at = now(),
      deactivated_at = NULL
  FROM chosen
  WHERE uum.id = (SELECT id FROM current_active)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_same)
  RETURNING uum.user_id, uum.feedback_config_rule_id
), inserted_first AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT $1, chosen.feedback_config_rule_id, true, now(), NULL
  FROM chosen
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_active)
  RETURNING user_id, feedback_config_rule_id
), final_assignment AS (
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM current_same
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM updated_current
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM inserted_first
)
SELECT u.userid, tu.usecase_id AS "usecaseId", tu.name AS "monitoringType"
FROM final_assignment fa
JOIN "User" u ON u.userid = fa.user_id
JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = fa.feedback_config_rule_id
JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id;

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS mapping_id,
    $2::boolean AS target_active
),

target_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    fcr.id,
    fcr.type,
    fcr.usecase_id,
    fcr.active AS old_active
  FROM feedback_config_rules fcr
  JOIN request r ON r.mapping_id = fcr.id
  WHERE fcr.id <> 9999
),

affected_users AS (
  SELECT
    uum.id AS user_mapping_id,
    uum.user_id,
    uum.feedback_config_rule_id,
    uum.assigned_at
  FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  JOIN target_mapping tm
    ON tm.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
  WHERE uum.active = true
),

chosen_replacements AS (
  SELECT
    au.user_mapping_id,
    au.user_id,
    au.feedback_config_rule_id AS old_feedback_config_rule_id,
    au.assigned_at AS old_assigned_at,

    COALESCE(
      historical.feedback_config_rule_id,
      default_mapping.feedback_config_rule_id
    ) AS new_feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM affected_users au
  JOIN target_mapping tm ON true

  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT uum2.feedback_config_rule_id
    FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum2
    JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr2
      ON fcr2.id = uum2.feedback_config_rule_id
    WHERE uum2.user_id = au.user_id
      AND uum2.active = false
      AND fcr2.active = true
      AND fcr2.usecase_id = tm.usecase_id
      AND fcr2.id <> tm.id
    ORDER BY uum2.assigned_at DESC, uum2.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) historical ON true

  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT fcr3.id AS feedback_config_rule_id
    FROM feedback_config_rules fcr3
    WHERE fcr3.active = true
      AND fcr3.usecase_id = tm.usecase_id
      AND fcr3.id <> tm.id
    ORDER BY fcr3.id
    LIMIT 1
  ) default_mapping ON true
),

blocking AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS users_without_replacement
  FROM chosen_replacements
  WHERE new_feedback_config_rule_id IS NULL
),

archive_old_assignments AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (
    user_id,
    feedback_config_rule_id,
    active,
    assigned_at,
    deactivated_at
  )
  SELECT
    cr.user_id,
    cr.old_feedback_config_rule_id,
    false,
    cr.old_assigned_at,
    now()
  FROM chosen_replacements cr
  CROSS JOIN request r
  CROSS JOIN blocking b
  WHERE r.target_active = false
    AND b.users_without_replacement = 0
    AND cr.new_feedback_config_rule_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id, user_id, feedback_config_rule_id
),

reassign_users AS (
  UPDATE "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  SET
    feedback_config_rule_id = cr.new_feedback_config_rule_id,
    active = true,
    assigned_at = now(),
    deactivated_at = NULL
  FROM chosen_replacements cr
  CROSS JOIN request r
  CROSS JOIN blocking b
  WHERE uum.id = cr.user_mapping_id
    AND r.target_active = false
    AND b.users_without_replacement = 0
    AND cr.new_feedback_config_rule_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING
    uum.id AS user_mapping_id,
    uum.user_id,
    cr.old_feedback_config_rule_id,
    uum.feedback_config_rule_id AS new_feedback_config_rule_id
),

update_rule AS (
  UPDATE feedback_config_rules fcr
  SET active = r.target_active
  FROM request r
  CROSS JOIN blocking b
  WHERE fcr.id = r.mapping_id
    AND fcr.id <> 9999
    AND (
      r.target_active = true
      OR b.users_without_replacement = 0
    )
  RETURNING
    fcr.id,
    fcr.active,
    fcr.type,
    fcr.usecase_id
)

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_mapping) THEN 404
    WHEN (SELECT target_active FROM request) = false
      AND (SELECT users_without_replacement FROM blocking) > 0 THEN 409
    ELSE 200
  END AS "statusCode",

  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_mapping)
      THEN 'Mapping ID not found'
    WHEN (SELECT target_active FROM request) = false
      AND (SELECT users_without_replacement FROM blocking) > 0
      THEN 'Cannot deactivate mapping because assigned users have no replacement mapping in the same use case'
    WHEN (SELECT target_active FROM request) = true
      THEN 'Mapping activated successfully'
    ELSE 'Mapping deactivated successfully and assigned users were reassigned'
  END AS message,

  json_build_object(
    'mappingId', (SELECT id FROM target_mapping),
    'type', (SELECT type FROM target_mapping),
    'usecaseId', (SELECT usecase_id FROM target_mapping),
    'active', COALESCE(
      (SELECT active FROM update_rule),
      (SELECT old_active FROM target_mapping)
    ),
    'affectedUsers', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM affected_users),
    'reassignedUsers', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reassign_users),
    'usersWithoutReplacement', (SELECT users_without_replacement FROM blocking),
    'reassignments', COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT json_agg(
          json_build_object(
            'userId', user_id,
            'userMappingId', user_mapping_id,
            'oldMappingId', old_feedback_config_rule_id,
            'newMappingId', new_feedback_config_rule_id
          )
          ORDER BY user_id
        )
        FROM reassign_users
      ),
      '[]'::json
    )
  ) AS data;
